hooks.command: s=.claude/hooks/setup-worktree.sh; [ -x "$s" ] || s="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$s"; if [ -x "$s" ]; then exec "$s"; else d=$(cat | jq -r '.worktree_path // .worktreePath // .path // .worktree // .cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null); d=${d:-$PWD}; echo "setup-worktree.sh not found; run pnpm install in $d yourself" >>~/.claude/worktree-hook.log; echo "$d"; fi
